fact: At a 29 September 2026 seminar the customs risk director presented a machine-learning simulation on 2025 data that could detect an additional 96.9 million dinars at a 49.23% detection rate, and the Finance Ministry IT centre said an AI tax-audit targeting project was at the bid-receipt stage with a one-year rollout.
title: Finances et douanes : l’IA bientôt au cœur du ciblage des dossiers à risque
